About the Team 
 The Corporate Security Team is ORTEC's central cybersecurity function. We protect ORTEC's people, systems, data, and services against cyber threats and work closely with IT, Cloud Operations, Development, and business stakeholders to continuously strengthen our security posture.
 Our team is responsible for a broad range of security domains, including:
Security Monitoring & Incident Response
Vulnerability Management
Cloud Security (Microsoft Azure & Microsoft 365)
Identity & Privileged Access Management
Endpoint Security
Dark Web & Brand Monitoring
Certificate & PKI Management
Security Awareness
 As a Senior Security Engineer, you will design, implement, manage, and continuously improve security controls and tooling across ORTEC's global environment. You will work closely with internal teams to detect threats, manage vulnerabilities, respond to incidents, and drive security improvements throughout the organization. This role is part of ORTEC's Corporate Security Team, where you will contribute to building a secure, resilient, and modern security capability. You will have the opportunity to influence security strategy, drive technical improvements, and help shape the future of security at ORTEC.
 This role is well suited for experienced security professionals who enjoy taking ownership, leading technical initiatives, and driving security improvements across a complex global environment.
 What You'll Do 
 As a Senior Security Engineer, you will:
Protect ORTEC's networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, systems, and applications against cybersecurity threats. 
Safeguard ORTEC and customer data by implementing and maintaining effective security controls. 
Ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and information. 
Manage, optimize, and continuously improve ORTEC's security tooling and technical security controls. 
Implement and maintain security controls within Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint management, and data protection environments.
Monitor security events and investigate threats using XDR, cloud security, and monitoring platforms. 
Support incident response activities and work closely with Incident Coordinators during security incidents. 
Drive the vulnerability management process by identifying, prioritizing, coordinating, and tracking remediation of vulnerabilities through vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, threat intelligence, and security advisories. 
Perform proactive threat and vulnerability analysis based on emerging risks and industry developments. 
Conduct technical security assessments and compliance checks in collaboration with system and application owners. 
Collaborate with IT, Cloud Operations, Development, and business stakeholders to implement security improvements and reduce risk. 
Identify opportunities to automate security operations, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities. 
Help define and improve technical security standards, policies, and procedures. 
Proactively identify recurring issues, security risks, and improvement opportunities, and drive initiatives that strengthen ORTEC's security posture.
Drive security automation and continuous improvement initiatives across ORTEC.
Collaborate with IT teams on networking, firewall, cloud, and platform security improvements.
Lead complex security improvement initiatives from design through implementation.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other security engineers and incident responders.
Act as a subject matter expert for security architecture, cloud security, and security operations initiatives.
 What We're Looking For 
 We are looking for an experienced security professional with strong technical expertise and a proven track record of driving security improvements in enterprise environments. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint management, networking, firewalls, DLP, system architecture, vulnerability management, incident response, or security monitoring is highly valued. A background in System Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Network Engineering, or Platform Engineering combined with strong security experience is considered a significant advantage.
 You are:
Technically strong, curious, and continuously developing your security expertise.
Proactive and pragmatic in your approach.
Comfortable working independently while collaborating with multiple teams.
Able to balance security requirements with business needs.
Passionate about continuously improving security processes, tooling, and capabilities.
Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can change based on emerging threats and business needs.
Comfortable leading initiatives, influencing stakeholders, and driving change across multiple teams.
 What we offer: 
A competitive salary of RON 18.010 - RON 22.000 month gross monthly - depending on interview evaluations. 
Meal tickets.
Performance-based annual bonus (up to one full salary).
A dynamic, technical, and intellectually stimulating environment.
Opportunities for continuous skill development in customer service and technical areas.
Exposure to real-world problem-solving in diverse industries, including retail, logistics, healthcare, energy, and more.
A unique and inspiring work experience in an open and creative environment.
Smart, enthusiastic, and fun colleagues.
Work-life balance and flexible scheduling.
Career development opportunities, including job rotation and performance-based growth.
Hybrid work model (office in Bucharest) with relaxation areas and on-site perks.
Social and wellness benefits, including private medical insurance, sports benefits, and a Bookster subscription.
Annual team events (teambuilding, summer party, Christmas party).
 If you recognize yourself in this role, we are really keen to hear from you. Please upload both your CV and also your motivation letter and we will get back to you as soon as possible after your application.
 About Corporate Security 
 Corporate Security is part of ORTEC's broader IT & Security organization. The team works closely with IT, Cloud Operations, Development, business stakeholders, and Legal & Compliance to improve ORTEC's security posture and ensure security is embedded across the organization.
 Corporate Security focuses on technical and operational security capabilities, including security tooling, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, security awareness, and technical security controls. Legal & Compliance oversees compliance frameworks, certifications, and formal assurance activities. Together, these teams help ensure that ORTEC remains secure, resilient, and compliant.
 Interested? 
 Are you passionate about safeguarding organizations against cyber threats and helping build a modern security capability? Join ORTEC's Corporate Security Team and help us protect and strengthen the security of our people, systems, data, and services worldwide.
